svg.title: From source revision to observed deployment
svg.desc: Illustrative deployment lifecycle. An Application source is pinned to Git revision 9f3a2c1. An optional Pipeline runs configured work. A Release renders manifests and applies to a Kubernetes target selected by Stage.cluster. Target health and desired/live synchronization are observed separately.
svg.text: From source revision to observed deployment
One source identity. Configured work. A Release. Evidence from the target.
Illustrative configuration · Pipeline work is optional; Stage selects the target.
